```text
Create amazing AI designs without the effort or the cost

Sign up for free

Create designs in any language, from quick marketing assets to text-heavy brochures.
How it works
Grafista is a content-first design platform. You add your text, images and branding and get complete designs in minutes.
```

{"decision": "pass", "reason": "页面主要是通用的 AI 设计 SaaS 营销文案，缺少具体的产品细节和可看到的成品样例。唯一略有新意的是 Blueprints（用参考重新生成设计而非编辑模板），但说明很空泛，不足以判断它是一个有趣的小产品。"}

verdict.reasoning: The reason calls the page generic AI-design SaaS marketing copy and says it lacks product details and visible examples (the blueprints section shows only 'Loading...'). It correctly describes Blueprints as references used to regenerate designs rather than templates to edit, which names a concrete feature. Both points support passing.
